Subject: Renewal discussion — term restructure + staged burst for Q3

Karthik,

Thanks for the renewal packet — I ran the numbers with our finance and cloud teams. We're excited to continue with Redwood but need to rearrange the term to match our fiscal planning and a staged ramp for burst capacity across Q3/Q4. A couple of asks up front: 

- Can Redwood support a 30-month structured term that front-loads reserved capacity in the first 6 months, then phases to a lower committed baseline (with defined burst lanes)?
- We need an explicit auto-renew opt-out clause — our procurement insists on a 90-day opt-out window.
- Pricing: can you provide a committed-rate tier for the first year and a separate uplift band for the staged burst months?

I've attached our usage forecast (Q1–Q2) and a rough ramp profile to make this concrete.

Appreciate a short call next week to line up a mutual action plan. Availability: Tue/Wed mornings PST.

--
Alex Navarro
Dir., Cloud Operations

Thanks,

Folks — summary from Alex's forecast and my proposal. Quick alignment so we can turn around the amendment Wed.

Key commercial asks from Brightwell:
- 30-month term with months 1–6 front-loaded at ~1.6x baseline commit, months 7–30 at baseline X, plus 3 burst tiers (low/med/high).
- 90-day opt-out window (procurement requirement).
- Price transparency: blended committed rate year 1, explicit uplift per burst tier.

Internal constraints / proposals: 
- Capacity: we can guarantee a dedicated GPU pool for months 1–3 (up to 120K tokens/sec aggregate) if they sign by June 15 and provide a 60% prepay of Year 1 credits. After month 3 we move to shared dedicated capacity with priority routing for burst windows.
- Discounting: propose 12% off list for Year 1 committed band (front-load included), then 5% floor for remainder of term. Burst uplifts: +18% / +35% / +60% on per-token for low/med/high.
- Legal: 90-day opt-out is doable but we should keep a clause that auto-renew applies to the baseline commit only; burst uplifts are billing-on-use with no auto-renew. Need legal review on minimum notice for reducing baseline post-opt-out (suggest 120-day notice).

Ask: Camila, can you prepare an ops note for the dedicated pool activation checklist and confirm GPU availability? Marissa, can you sign off on the discount bands and the prepay requirement (60%) for guaranteed dedicated capacity?

I'll own the MAP and delivery of the amendment.

Thanks — K
